## Keys

Key bindings the TUI handles. What each one does depends on the view; see [The terminal UI](/software-factory/belai/tui/).

`ctrl+b`, `ctrl+c`, `ctrl+d`, `ctrl+end`, `ctrl+g`, `ctrl+home`, `ctrl+j`, `ctrl+l`, `ctrl+o`, `ctrl+p`, `ctrl+q`, `ctrl+r`, `ctrl+s`, `ctrl+space`, `ctrl+t`, `ctrl+u`, `ctrl+v`, `ctrl+x`, `ctrl+y`, `f1`, `f10`, `f11`, `f12`, `f2`, `f3`, `f4`, `f5`, `f6`, `f7`, `f8`, `f9`, `shift+down`, `shift+left`, `shift+right`, `shift+tab`, `shift+up`
